en-US: Display attached files as consistent compact cards with recognizable type icons; PDF cards now toggle preview on click and load reliably in the desktop app.
Keep image uploads visually stable in the editor and clear image selection predictably when clicking the canvas.
zh-CN: 将附件统一显示为紧凑文件卡片并提供清晰的类型图标；PDF 卡片现在可单击切换预览，并在桌面端稳定加载。
图片上传时在编辑器中保持稳定的视觉占位，并在单击画布时可靠清除图片选中状态。
